name: Codo – battle of the Montserrat requetés
story: At the start of the Zaragoza offensive the Republican 25th Division attacked the small village of Codo, between Belchite and Quinto. It was held by the Tercio de Nuestra Señora de Montserrat, a battalion of Catalan Carlist volunteers (requetés) of about 200 men, together with other troops. Encircled on 24 August, the defenders fought on until the survivors broke out on 25 August. The battalion suffered very heavy losses and ceased to exist as a fighting unit. Its 1st and 2nd companies later received the Laureate Cross of San Fernando.
see: A small village rebuilt after the war, with a commemorative cross to the fallen requetés.
plan: Codo is a short drive from Belchite and easily combined with Belchite and Quinto. The pin marks the village; ask locally for the memorial cross.

boxes.text: Published casualty totals differ, and many come from sources written on the requeté side, so no single figure is given here.
